description: This is a Python source file implementing a JSON schema loader and parser for a code generation system, including classes for JSON types, objects, arrays, methods, and schema processing functions.

classes.name: JsonType
classes.description: Base class for JSON schema types, providing common properties and methods for name handling, type identification, and code generation helpers.

classes.name: JsonNull
classes.description: Represents a JSON null type with C++ type 'void'.

classes.name: JsonBoolean
classes.description: Represents a JSON boolean type with C++ class 'CoreJson("Boolean")' and native type 'bool'.

classes.name: JsonInteger
classes.description: Represents a JSON integer type with configurable size and sign, providing C++ class and native type.

classes.name: AuxJsonInteger
classes.description: Generated auxiliary JSON integer type with default size and sign.

classes.name: AuxJsonAuto
classes.description: Generated auxiliary JSON type with native type 'auto'.

classes.name: JsonNumber
classes.description: Represents a floating point JSON number with configurable size ('float' or 'double').

classes.name: JsonString
classes.description: Represents a JSON string type with C++ class 'CoreJson("String")' and native type 'string'.

classes.name: JsonInstanceId
classes.description: Represents a JSON instance ID with native type 'Core::instance_id'.

classes.name: JsonRefCounted
classes.description: Provides reference counting for JSON objects to handle duplicates and shared references.

classes.name: JsonTime
classes.description: Represents a JSON time type with conversion methods for ISO8601 format.

classes.name: JsonMacAddress
classes.description: Represents a MAC address type with conversion to string.

classes.name: JsonEnum
classes.description: Represents a JSON enum type with size determination and duplicate handling.

classes.name: JsonObject
classes.description: Represents a JSON object with properties, nested objects, and duplicate handling.

classes.name: JsonArray
classes.description: Represents a JSON array with item type and delegate methods.

classes.name: JsonMethod
classes.description: Represents a JSON method with parameters, result, and associated metadata.

classes.name: JsonNotification
classes.description: Represents a JSON notification with ID and status listener info.

classes.name: JsonCallback
classes.description: Represents a callback associated with a notification.

classes.name: JsonProperty
classes.description: Represents a property of a JSON object, with read/write flags and endpoint names.

classes.name: JsonRpcSchema
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC schema with interface info, methods, and include handling.

methods.name: SetLogger
methods.description: Sets the global logger for logging issues.

methods.name: Tstring
methods.description: Returns a string wrapped in '_T()' macro.

methods.name: Scoped
methods.description: Generates a scoped name for JSON objects considering hierarchy and namespace.

methods.name: CoreJson
methods.description: Constructs a core JSON type string with prefix.

methods.name: MakeObject
methods.description: Creates an object type name with suffix.

methods.name: MakeEnum
methods.description: Creates an enum type name with suffix.

methods.name: JsonItem
methods.description: Factory function to create JSON type objects based on schema.

methods.name: LoadSchema
methods.description: Loads and processes a JSON schema file, resolving references and includes.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Main entry point to load schemas or interface headers, returning parsed schemas.
